skills.name: 诗怨
skills.text: 每回合每项限一次，当你成为其他角色使用牌的目标后，若该角色的体力值大于/等于/小于你，你可以摸三/二/一张牌。
notes: Trigger target-draw: cardUseTargetsFinalized, ownerRelation target, onlyDesignatedCardTargets (borrowed-sword odd pair targets excluded, mirroring the 荐降 boundary), optional, condition not(cardActionActorIsOwner); one candidate per actual use, so a multi-target card prompts once.

Bespoke op shiYuanTargetDraw (7236): compares the targeting character's live HP with the owner's (greater/equal/less → 3/2/1 cards), counts this turn's prior accepted draws of the same option from ProgramShiYuanTargetDrawEvent ledger entries, and draws with reason skill-program.ol:shiyuan.target-draw.

The per-option limit (1, or 2 while 余威 is active) is evaluated twice: at candidate eligibility (CanRunShiYuanTargetDraw, so an exhausted option never reaches the chooser) and defensively at execution.

Declining the optional prompt does not consume the option; only an accepted draw commits evidence. The ledger is history-derived with no serialized runtime state; cold recovery replays the accepted commands into the same state.

skills.name: 毒逝
skills.text: 锁定技，①当你死亡时，你令一名其他角色获得此技能；②当你进入濒死状态时，其他角色不能在此次濒死结算中对你使用【桃】。
notes: Clause ① trigger death-grant: ownerDied, subject owner, mandatory, effects selectTarget(otherLiving) then bespoke op duShiGrantSkill (7237) which calls the shared AcquireRuntimeSkills so the recipient owns the complete skill (both clauses) through a runtime grant; ProgramDuShiGrantEvent records the transfer. A later death of the recipient re-fires the same trigger, so the skill keeps propagating.

Clause ② card policy dyingSelfRescueOnly (new shared kind, exactly Peach): the shared rescue gate CanUsePeachToRescue now denies rescues where responder != victim while the victim holds the policy; the dying holder may still rescue themself, and the restriction is evaluated per rescue attempt, which is exactly the per-dying-settlement scope of the text.
Clause ② needs no trigger: the policy travels with every enabled ol:dushi instance, including runtime grants received through clause ①.

skills.name: 余威
skills.text: 主公技，锁定技，其他群势力角色的回合内，“诗怨”改为“每回合每项限两次”。
notes: Trigger qun-turn-activation: playPhaseStarting, subject owner, turnOwnerScope otherLiving, mandatory, condition turnOwnerFactionIs([qun]) (new tail condition kind reading a dependency-gated TurnOwnerFactionId fact); bespoke op yuWeiMarkActiveTurn (7238) commits ProgramYuWeiActiveTurnEvent for the running turn.

诗怨 reads the ledger: ShiYuanTurnLimit returns 2 while a ProgramYuWeiActiveTurnEvent exists for the current turn number, otherwise 1. The play-phase boundary is the earliest shared window that covers every use made during that character's turn; turnOwnerScope is not accepted by turnStartBeforeNormalFlow, so uses before the play-phase boundary are the one documented gap.
Tags: SkillTag.Lord | SkillTag.Locked with trigger execution form, following the boundary 暴虐 registration pattern; identity mode does not role-suppress printed lord skills (shared codebase口径).
